title: 第5章 快去请曹督造第6章 阿基米德原理
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
“他的病还是没有好转吗？”
太平公主宋南烛的视线透过窗户，落在专注读书的清瘦身影上。
这段时间，沈无名的头发也长长了不少，而且也开始了修炼。
读书之时，头顶便有一缕缕云烟飘浮，这是儒家修士的才气，也叫浩然正气。
“嗯！”
楚幼仪轻叹一声，“安神汤天天喝，还是一样，想不起来，不过除此之外也没有别的！”
“都怪我！”
时间过去了两个月，但宋南烛的自责并未减少，反而更加浓郁。
她也听小花说了。
沈无名十多年苦读诗书，就是为了在科举一鸣惊人。
但是现在……
“他这段时间都在看书，还是想考科举吧！”
“但乡试没多久了，他来得及吗？”
楚幼仪轻叹，没说话。
小花却没心没肺，“肯定来不及，人家十年寒窗，都考不上呢！”
“侯爷当年科举考了三次都没考上，才不得不得从军！”
“姑爷什么都不记得了，怎么可能考中？没得病之前还差不多！”
听到这，宋南烛的脸色更白了。
这么说，都是她的错，因为她的莽撞，导致沈无名十多年的辛苦白费了。
“我一定会想办法治好他的，我犯的错，我自己承担！”

……
“姑爷，吃饭啦！”
小花的声音清脆响亮，在饭厅嚎一嗓子，半个侯府都听得到。
沈无名合上手中的书，封面上有几个雕版印刷的字。
道教义枢！
这是道藏之一，是关于修炼的书籍。
书房里面的书他已经看完了。
前几天，楚幼仪就将修炼的书拿给他看。
书中所言。
百家各有法门，但是整体来看的，主流的还是儒家读书人、兵家武夫。
其次是道、佛、法、墨、阴阳、纵横、农、名、医等等。
所谓万般皆下品，唯有读书高。
由此可见儒家的地位。
沈无名本着不吃软饭的原则，也开始尝试修炼。
不过没人指点，进度似乎并不快。
【宿主：沈无名】
【技能：诗经（lv3）、说文解字（lv3）、道教义枢（lv0）、秦越人切脉法（lv0）】
沈无名放下书，随手一挥，手上出现一道带有神韵的白气。
content_en:
"Is his condition still not getting better?"
Princess Taiping Song Nanzhu's gaze fell on the thin figure who was concentrating on reading through the window.
During this time, Shen Wuming's hair also grew a lot longer, and he also started practicing.
When reading, there will be wisps of clouds and smoke floating above the head. This is the talent of Confucian monks, also called Haoran Zhengqi.
"Yeah!"
Chu Youyi sighed softly, "I drink the calming soup every day, but it's still the same. I can't remember it, but there's nothing else!"
"It's all my fault!"
Two months have passed, but Song Nanzhu's self-blame has not diminished, but has become more intense.
She also heard what Xiaohua said.
Shen Wuming studied poetry and books for more than ten years in order to become famous in the imperial examination.
But now...
"He has been reading during this period, and he still wants to take the imperial examination!"
"But the provincial examination is not long ago, will he be able to do it in time?"
Chu Youyi sighed and said nothing.
Xiaohua, however, was careless and said, "It's definitely too late. I've been living in poverty for ten years and can't even pass the exam!"
"The Marquis failed to pass the imperial examination three times, so he had to join the army!"
"My uncle doesn't remember anything, how could he pass the exam? He was pretty much the same before he got sick!"
Hearing this, Song Nanzhu's face turned even paler.
In this way, it was all her fault, because her recklessness caused more than ten years of Shen Wuming's hard work to be wasted.
"I will definitely find a way to cure him. I will bear the responsibility for the mistakes I make!"
…
"Uncle, it's time to eat!"
Xiaohua's voice was clear and loud. She howled in the dining room and could be heard by half of the Hou family.
Shen Wuming closed the book in his hand. There were several words printed on the cover.
Taoist teachings!
This is one of the Taoist canons, a book about cultivation.
He has already finished reading the books in the study.
A few days ago, Chu Youyi showed him the cultivation book.
What the book says.
Each school has its own method, but overall, the mainstream ones are Confucian scholars and military strategists.
Followed by Taoism, Buddhism, Dharma, Mohism, Yin and Yang, Zongheng, Agriculture, Ming, Medicine and so on.
It is said that everything is inferior, only reading is superior.
This shows the status of Confucianism.
Shen Wuming also started to try to practice based on the principle of not eating soft food.
However, no one gave any guidance, and the progress seemed not to be fast.
[Host: Shen Wuming]
[Skills: Book of Songs (lv3), Shuowen Jiezi (lv3), Taoist teachings (lv0), Qinyue people's pulse-taking method (lv0)]
Shen Wuming put down the book and waved his hand, and a white aura with charm appeared on his hand.
